name: Narrated explainer
summary: A narrated concept explainer. One recurring visual metaphor is built up across sections that agents write in parallel.
steps: Ask only how it looks and moves (docs/looks.md): 3–4 looks made up for this subject (a 1–3 word name + a ≤12-word line each), 1–2 palettes besides theirs, the length, and where it will be watched if that isn't obvious; a backdrop that fits (anim sheet <video> --scene <id> --backdrops); write style.md and theme.json (with `roles` for sketches)
Write narration.txt: a hook question, then one idea per sentence, with a {cue:word} on every word the picture should land on

Plan scene.json: the hero objects shared across sections, keys (the handoff states between sections), one concrete brief per section and a `sketch` of each (8–12 paths, docs/format.md). Set section targets with anim timing, then anim plan <video> and show the storyboard before generating
anim gen scene <video> --scene <id> (every section not written yet, in parallel; anim preview shows each one land)
anim lint <video> (including the docs/motion.md rules: thumbnail, end-hold, no-beat), then anim sheet per section; fix or regenerate weak sections
anim render <video>, then anim eval voice <video>

scaffold.narration: Hook question about the topic? {cue:intro}First idea in one sentence. {cue:idea2}Second idea, building on the first. {cue:idea3}How it all fits together, and why it matters.

sections.brief: Hook and the hero object. Frame 0 is the thumbnail, so the hook line is already up at 0 (pre-roll it): show the question, then introduce the recurring visual (shared object) at cue:intro. End on key s1.
Second idea, built on the hero object. Land each beat on its cue. End with clear (it takes the local objects off), on key s2.
Pull it together: the whole picture, and why it matters. Last section: the beats finish 3 s before the end and the final picture holds.
